Reads one of your datasets: for each item, the row whose key is the item's, put on it, items with none going out of missing; or every row, the newest 1,000 at most, an item each.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `data.read` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main`, `missing` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead. It only reads, so what fails is tried again 3 more times to begin with, as **Retry** says.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dataset (`dataset`) | dataset | yes |  | The dataset read: one of yours. Personal: sharing the workflow leaves it out. |
| Read (`read`) | text | no | `by key` | By key: for each item, the row last added with its key. Every row: the dataset's rows, an item each, oldest first. One of `by key`, `every row`. |
| Key (`key`) | text or a number | no |  | By key: each item's key, like {{ city }}, as the dataset's key field has it. |
| Rows (`limit`) | whole number | no | `1000` | Every row: the newest so many, up to 1,000. |
| Row field (`field`) | text | no | `row` | Where the row goes on the item. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added, `row` under the name **Row field** (`field`) gives; with **Read** (`read`) `every row`, items with only these instead. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `row` | anything | The row: an object of the dataset's fields. |
